problem: Ask for contact email when placing an order, not when creating an account
symptom: An agent proposed hiding email independently in each profile controller

root_cause.cause: The identity and checkout contact purposes may have been conflated
root_cause.owner: Unknown until the identity provider and order data contract are inspected

evidence.source: Illustrative project hypothesis, not repository evidence
evidence.finding: The registration rule may require email despite checkout owning contact details

options.approach: Hide email separately in profile controllers
options.tradeoff: Leaves registration and persistence policy unchanged

options.approach: Clarify identity and order email ownership
options.tradeoff: Requires auth, migration, order and retention evidence

invariants.rule: Account recovery must continue to work
invariants.proof: Run existing authentication integration tests after verifying identity requirements

invariants.rule: Order contact email remains available for receipts
invariants.proof: Run order receipt contract test after identifying the contact data owner

decision.reason: Identity and order ownership are not established by source evidence
decision.invalidated_by: Verified auth and checkout contracts that establish the appropriate boundary
